ctx_fields.head: +0xc0 current head node

gate.rule: block-1 rotation and path-B evict splice run only when [arg2+0x13450] >= [global]; otherwise skipped

key_compare.meaning: +1 node key smaller, 0 equal, -1 node key greater

paths.evict_slot: old head tag bits nonzero: slot-insert OLD head into ctx+0xc8, +0xb8++, then +0xa8++ and [ctx+0xc0] = node
paths.evict_structure: old head tag bits zero: splice old head into the +0xd8-anchored structure (gated by the arg2/global check), then +0xa8++ and [ctx+0xc0] = node
paths.slot_insert: node key >= head key, or head NULL: slot-insert node into ctx+0xc8, +0xb8++, return; head unchanged
paths.unlink_anchor: [ctx+0xd8] == node on entry: if [node+0x28] == node, [ctx+0xd8] = 0; else [ctx+0xd8] = [node+0x28] and the block-1 rotation runs
